opening: The pain gets better when I lean forward.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I've noticed a high-pitched sound when I breathe in.
My voice has become deeper, softer or hoarse.

opening.text: I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I've noticed a high-pitched sound when I breathe in, and my voice has become deeper, softer or hoarse. The pain gets better when I lean forward.
